title: House of the Dragon
overview: King Viserys names his daughter Rhaenyra heir. After he dies, the court crowns her half-brother Aegon instead. The realm splits into Blacks and Greens, and the Dance of the Dragons begins — a family war fought with the last great dragons.

characters.name: Rhaenyra Targaryen
characters.plot: Named heir, then usurped. Leads the war for the Iron Throne from Dragonstone.

dragon.name: Syrax
dragon.note: Her golden she-dragon; often kept close to home.

characters.name: Daemon Targaryen
characters.plot: Warrior-prince, unpredictable ally. Presses the war hard and rarely asks permission.

dragon.name: Caraxes
dragon.note: The Blood Wyrm — long, lean, and built for a fight.

characters.name: Jacaerys Velaryon
characters.plot: Heir apparent on her side. Brokers alliances and bears the weight of disputed parentage.

dragon.name: Vermax
dragon.note: Younger dragon; grows into the war with him.

characters.name: Baela Targaryen
characters.plot: Fierce and forward. Carries Velaryon and Targaryen blood into every fight she can reach.

dragon.name: Moondancer
dragon.note: Small, quick, and deadly in a scrap.

characters.name: Addam of Hull
characters.plot: A shipyard bastard who claims a riderless dragon — and Corlys’s trust.

dragon.name: Seasmoke
dragon.note: Once Laenor’s; chooses Addam in the war.

characters.name: Corlys Velaryon
characters.plot: Sea power and pragmatic loyalty. The Blacks’ fleet often hinges on him.

characters.name: Alicent Hightower
characters.plot: Raised beside Rhaenyra, then locked into crowning her own son. Conscience and politics keep colliding.

characters.name: Aegon II Targaryen
characters.plot: Reluctant crown, real consequences. The Greens’ answer to Rhaenyra’s claim.

dragon.name: Sunfyre
dragon.note: Gorgeous and vicious — a king’s dragon in gold.

characters.name: Aemond Targaryen
characters.plot: Claims the largest living dragon and turns every slight into a campaign.

dragon.name: Vhagar
dragon.note: Oldest and largest — a living siege engine.

characters.name: Helaena Targaryen
characters.plot: Speaks in riddles that keep coming true. The war breaks her gently, then all at once.

dragon.name: Dreamfyre
dragon.note: Pale and ancient; more omen than weapon in her hands.

characters.name: Otto Hightower
characters.plot: Architect of the Green coup. Plays the long game until the board catches fire.

characters.name: Criston Cole
characters.plot: From Rhaenyra’s sworn shield to the Greens’ sharpest edge on the ground.

weekly.status: Season 3 finished airing August 2026. Weekly recaps pause until Season 4.

episodes.title: Salt and Sea, Fire and Blood
episodes.recap: The season opens with the war already ugly. Old alliances strain, and both courts stop pretending this stays contained.

episodes.title: Queen's Landing
episodes.recap: Power in King’s Landing gets personal. Crowns, councils, and quiet knives decide who still has a seat.

episodes.title: Rhaenyra Triumphant
episodes.recap: The Blacks take a swing that lands. Momentum shifts — and so does who feels safe on dragonback.

episodes.title: Tumbleton
episodes.recap: A town becomes a warning. Dragonseed politics and battlefield chaos rewrite who can be trusted.

episodes.title: Unbowed and Unbent
episodes.recap: Houses dig in. Negotiations fail the way they always do in this war — loudly, then with fire.

episodes.title: Faceless Men
episodes.recap: Masks, missions, and unpaid debts. The fight leaves the open sky for darker corridors.

episodes.title: The Dragon in Winter
episodes.recap: Cold choices. A dragon’s shadow falls on whatever hope either side still called mercy.

episodes.title: Season Finale
episodes.recap: Season 3 closes the middle of the Dance. Lines are drawn for the next war — and fewer riders are left to cross them.
